cortical: Aligned heatmaps follow 2,883 exons through two mouse cortical age series. Median late-minus-early inclusion is about +0.21 and +0.19 for M2 and close to zero for M3. In the latest age bin, the three sensory receptor samples score at cortical stage 1, while all five ganglion and four central neuron samples score at stage 6.
robo: A splice diagram shows inclusion or skipping of exon 6b. The normalised crossing ratio averages 1.00 in wild type, 0.52 after Nova1/2 loss and 0.84 after editing both ROBO loci in that background. At E10.5, the mean lumbar commissure ratio rises from 0.21 in wild type to 0.40 with Robo1 exon deletion. Animal and measurement counts are tabulated separately.
routes: Four molecular routes lead to different readouts. A floor-plate cue enables local ROBO3.2 production and translation-coupled RNA decay. RBM20 regulates titin spring exon exclusion and thereby changes spring length. Including the Tra2b poison exon reduces productive output. Loss of that exon disrupts meiotic prophase. Astrocytes release soluble DLK1 by cleavage. A neural stem cell requires its own membrane-bound form to respond to soluble DLK1 by forming more neurospheres.
snap25: In both homozygous mouse lines all detected Snap25 RNA has the 5a form. With the cassette retained, protein averages 80.7% of line-matched wild type. With the cassette excised, protein averages 110.9%. Symbols distinguish lines and whiskers show published standard errors.
fruitless: Twenty-four males were tested in each of nine timed knockdown cohorts. The stage-5 cohort had a median courtship index of 7%, compared with 60% at stage 4 and 67% at stage 6. The corresponding mating counts were 0, 3 and 5 of 24. Each cohort is visible as individual courtship points and a separate mating count. In nematodes, fusion normally occurs in L4. Expression of either LIN-29 isoform beginning in L1 advanced fusion to early L2.
timing: In one constructed example, region 1 switches from 0.2 to 0.8 before region 2. In another, region 1 briefly reaches 0.8 and returns to 0.2 while region 2 stays at 0.2. Both absolute regional differences are 0, 0, 0.6, 0 and 0.
